Auth.checkEmail: Check {email} for a link to verify your account. If you already have an account, sign in instead.
Auth.verificationSent: If this email still needs verifying, a new link is on its way.
Auth.resetEmailSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

errors.declared21PlusRequired: You must be 21 or older to join.
errors.declaredInPhRequired: You must be in the Philippines to join.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password is wrong.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Verify your email before signing in. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: That email link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.intro: Tantiya is for adults 21 and over in the Philippines, one account per person. A short ID check confirms both.
verify.needId: A valid ID: PhilID or ePhilID, passport, driver's license or UMID
verify.needSelfie: A selfie and a short liveness check
verify.needLight: Good light and your phone's camera
verify.dataProvider: Didit, our verification provider, takes the photos and checks them. Tantiya keeps the result, not your ID images.
verify.dataMinimal: We collect only your ID, selfie and liveness check. No address or income.
verify.continueNote: You'll continue on Didit's secure page, then come back here.

underReview.title: Under review
underReview.body: A staff member reviews every application.
underReview.grantNote: Your starting {coins, number} coins arrive once you're approved.

notFinished.title: ID check not finished
notFinished.body: Your application can't be reviewed until you finish the ID check.

full.title: Applications are full this month
full.body: We can check only a limited number of IDs each month. You can apply from <nowrap>{date}</nowrap>.
full.saved: Your account is saved, so you won't need to sign up again.

notApproved.title: We couldn't approve your application
notApproved.applyAgainNote: This starts a new ID check on Didit's page, in English.

reasons.id_unreadable: We couldn't read your ID. The photo was blurred or cut off.
reasons.id_type_not_accepted: We can't accept that type of ID.
reasons.face_mismatch: Your selfie didn't match the photo on your ID.
reasons.under_21: Tantiya is only for adults 21 and over.
reasons.outside_ph: Tantiya is only for people in the Philippines.
reasons.duplicate_person: This person already has a Tantiya account. Each person can have only one.
reasons.document_suspect: We couldn't confirm that your ID is genuine.

actions.id_unreadable: Take the ID check again with the whole ID in frame, in good light.
actions.id_expired: Apply again with an ID that is still valid.
actions.id_type_not_accepted: Apply again with a PhilID or ePhilID, passport, driver's license or UMID.
actions.face_mismatch: Take the ID check again with your face clearly visible, in good light.
actions.liveness_failed: Take the ID check again and follow the steps on screen, in good light.
actions.other: Take the ID check again. If it happens again, email us.

approved.title: Your account is approved
approved.body: A staff member reviewed your application. You can now make forecasts.
approved.playMoney: Play money: coins can't be bought, cashed out or traded.

receiving.title: Receiving your result
receiving.body: We are still receiving your verification. This page will update in a moment.
receiving.leave: You can leave this page and check back here later.

declarations.title: Confirm two things first
declarations.body: We need both before the ID check can start.

startError.title: We couldn't start the ID check
startError.body: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.
startError.saved: Your account and answers are saved.

BetSlip.openedAt: Opened at {lines} · lines move automatically as bets come in
BetSlip.fixedNote: Odds, To win and Total return are fixed when you place the bet. No fee: the house margin is in the line.
BetSlip.wholeCoins: Enter a whole number of coins.
BetSlip.notApproved: You can bet once your account is approved.
BetSlip.movedBody: The line for {label} changed before your bet went in. Nothing has been staked yet.
BetSlip.placedNote: These terms are fixed. Lines move automatically as bets come in.

errors.excluded: Betting is paused on your account (break or self-exclusion).
errors.invalid_stake: Enter a stake of at least 1 coin.
errors.outcome_not_found: This outcome no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.market_closed: This market is closed to new bets.
errors.stake_limit: This bet would go over your stake limit.
errors.stake_too_small: Stake more to win at least 1 coin at this line.

Community.title: Community
Community.signIn: Sign in to read and join the Community.
Community.readOnly: You can read posts now. Posting, liking and commenting open once your account is approved.
Community.guidelines: Share forecasts and sources. Be civil: no tips for sale, no politics or elections, no personal information. Moderators may hide posts that break these rules.
Community.empty: No posts yet. Be the first to share a forecast.
Community.hiddenNote: Removed by moderators. Only you can see this post.
Community.likesLabel: Like, {count, plural, one {# like} other {# likes}}
Community.reportWhy: Why are you reporting this post?
Community.reportDone: Thanks. A moderator will review it. The author isn't told who reported it.
Community.reportAlready: You've already reported this post. A moderator will review it.
Community.nameToComment: Choose a display name to comment.
Community.displayNameHelp: 2–40 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes. Other members see this name; your ID name is never shown.

nameErrors.invalid_name: Use 2–40 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
nameErrors.name_taken: That name is taken. Try another.

Community.placeholder: Share a forecast, a source or a question
Community.forecastNote: If you have an open bet in the market, your side is shown on the post. Your stake and winnings never are.

postErrors.cannot_post: Your account can't post right now.
